description: Scan the working folder (recursively, any subfolder name) for XISF/FITS files and report each one's FILTER header value, geometry, exposure, whether it has an astrometric solution (WCS keywords CTYPE/CRVAL with a CD, CDELT or PC matrix, or PixInsight's PCL:AstrometricSolution properties), and its INSTRUME, TELESCOP, FOCALLEN, XPIXSZ, YPIXSZ and XBINNING keywords verbatim (null when absent). The connector's own state and output folders are not scanned. Read-only.
name: scan_workspace
